Pasal 10(1) huruf g also involves “pemuka adat” (customary leaders). These are direct traditional/cultural engagement provisions. The retrieved candidates included Article 11 (with “customary, cultural, religious institutions”), so the judge’s ‘No’ conclusion was a misinterpretation/overly strict reading despite sufficient evidence.
